scope: Data-only cohort and coverage analysis; no new model training or ranking metrics.
selection_rule_declared_before_heldout_c: Select the first 2,500 reviewers ordered by SHA256("42:" + reviewer_id) among those with at least five full-history positive ratings in every domain. This expands the existing nested hash cohort 2.5x, keeps genuine three-domain users, and applies no item- or held-out-outcome filter. Selection does not read test events.

definitions.globally_late: The item’s first raw-source rating timestamp is after this reviewer’s V1 train cutoff.
definitions.external_prior: At least one >=4 source rating by a reviewer outside V1 occurred before this reviewer’s train cutoff; this is point-in-time history, not the full-source per-user train split.
definitions.larger_pool_train: The item has a positive training event in the nested 5,000-user hash cohort but none in V1.
definitions.validation_only: The item occurs in V1 validation but not in V1 training.

v1_original_1000.name: v1_original_1000
v1_original_1000.description: Frozen V1 hash-selected cohort, re-read from the full source.

higher_activity_10_each.name: higher_activity_10_each
higher_activity_10_each.description: All reviewers with at least 10 full-history positive interactions per domain.

hash_2500.name: hash_2500
hash_2500.description: First 2,500 under the V1 SHA-256 order among users with >=5 positives in every domain.

hash_5000.name: hash_5000
hash_5000.description: First 5,000 under the same SHA-256 order.

training_support_2500.name: training_support_2500
training_support_2500.description: Top 2,500 of the hash-ordered 5,000 by minimum then total count of train positives on items with pool train frequency >=2; hash breaks ties.

training_support_selection.basis: train positives only; item support is measured in the 5,000-user hash pool

hash_2500_train_item_min_2.name: hash_2500_train_item_min_2
hash_2500_train_item_min_2.description: Hash-2500 users; only training rows on items with cohort train frequency >=2 are retained.

hash_2500_train_item_min_3.name: hash_2500_train_item_min_3
hash_2500_train_item_min_3.description: Hash-2500 users; only training rows on items with cohort train frequency >=3 are retained.

v1_equal_step_run_start_gap_seconds.note: Empirical adjacent run-start gaps from seeds 45-47; approximate end-to-end run time, not isolated training time.

runtime_reference.note: A fixed-step V2 training run processes the same 1,638,400 examples as V1, but validation ranking work is estimated to be larger; wall time is not extrapolated from that ratio.

selected_v2.decision_reason: Predeclared mid-sized hash expansion: 2.5x V1 population, no item/test filtering, and a nested sample that preserves all V1 users.
